name: shell_exec
title: Run Shell Command
description: Execute a shell command on the selected HHC client using the platform shell (cmd.exe with /d /s /c on Windows, /bin/bash with -lc elsewhere). Write nested PowerShell explicitly via powershell.exe; do not assume PowerShell syntax on Windows. Fallback tool: prefer dedicated HHC filesystem, process, service, log, browser and system tools whenever they can perform the requested operation. High-risk operation: executes arbitrary commands on the host. client_id and command are mandatory; commands run bounded with timeouts and truncated output. User confirmation is recommended before execution.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

command.description: Shell command line executed on the selected client (cmd.exe on Windows, /bin/bash elsewhere).

cwd.description: Optional absolute working directory. When omitted, HHC uses the target host canonical runtime root.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound in seconds for the command.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

timed_out.description: Whether the command hit its time bound.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
